messages:
incident-bot: Pager — detected spike in 5xx and DNS SERVFAIL for private VNet egress in azure-southeurope. Affected: Redwood Private + Dedicated customers in EU. Alert level: P1. Paging oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: Ack, I'm awake. Pulling logs and routing. Giving 2-min ETA.

infra-jen: I see NXDOMAIN/SERVFAIL from our Private DNS forwarders (10.2.0.5) for customer zones. Also intermittent BGP withdraws from azure-peers in southeurope.

infra-jen: dig output:
```
$ dig @10.2.0.5 api.customer.internal A +short

; <<>> DiG 9.16.1 <<>> @10.2.0.5 api.customer.internal A +short
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: SERVFAIL, id: 1234
```

ops-lee: Traceroute to affected egress ip (20.45.67.89) shows timeout at azure-peering-hop:
```
$ traceroute 20.45.67.89
 1 10.0.0.1 ...
 5 * * *
 6 52.239.10.1 (azure-peering-hop) 120 ms 118 ms *
```

ops-lee: Rolling temporarily to public egress to restore customer traffic. @matt can you open NAT+route fallback in southeurope?

matt: Doing it now. Creating new route rule to prefer internet egress for private subnets and attaching NAT gateway. Will push via infra-console (stack id: infra-eu-2026). ETA 4m.

customer-success-julie: BrightBank is on phone, seeing transaction failures ~15:20 UTC. They want ETA. Please update.

oncall-sre: Noted. Julie, tell them we're failing over to public egress and will confirm in ~6m. Apologize and offer monitoring link.

matt: Push complete. Rules:
```
- route table id rtb-eu-53: set next-hop -> nat-gw-eu-03
- priority 100, propagate false
```

matt: Confirming flows now; 200 OKs returning to BrightBank. Latency slightly higher but service healthy.

infra-jen: Azure support contacted (ticket 123456789). They acknowledged 'investigating backbone route flap affecting private peering'.

ops-lee: Gradual recovery in metrics. Error rate dropped from 12% -> 0.8% over last 10m.

incident-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-3456, severity=P1, sla=start 1965432100.

maria: Taking handoff at 1965433000 from oncall-sre to watch for reversion and coordinate with Azure.

oncall-sre: Handoff to maria acknowledged. Key facts: root cause suspected BGP withdraws at azure peering for southeurope causing DNS resolvers to fail — we mitigated via public egress fallback and NAT.

andy: Customer impact: BrightBank (dedicated private) experienced ~12 minutes of 5xxs and transaction failures. Other private customers saw degraded DNS resolution; no data loss observed.

maria: Action items:
- monitor for 2h post-handoff (maria)
- get full PCAP and DNS logs for windows of 15:15-15:35 UTC (infra-jen)
- escalate with Azure with packet captures and BGP adjacency logs (andy/matt)
- postmortem owner: andy (deadline 72h)

customer-success-julie: Sent interim update to BrightBank with mitigation notes and we offered SLA credits if requested.

oncall-sre: Closing page — will remain on-call until handoff at 1965433000. Thanks team :thumbsup:
